reason: The cited evidence does not address laser re-melting of thermal-sprayed coatings, thickness enhancement, or FeCoNiCrAl alloys. E1 describes a different process (electro-spark deposition) and E2 describes laser cladding of a different HEA, not post-deposition re-melting. The key premises therefore lack specific prior support.
premises: Laser re-melting can fuse thermal-spray splats into a densified layer
Laser re-melting can increase effective coating thickness
Inert atmosphere prevents oxidation during laser re-melting
Laser re-melting is applicable to FeCoNiCrAl high-entropy alloy bond coats
Laser re-melting preserves coating integrity without substrate dilution or phase transformations
